- 803 — Batch Normalization (planned) -> 802 — Normalize Text (planned) -> 801 — Text Foundation (verified). Closure: 802, 801.
- 804 — Count Lines (planned) -> 801 — Text Foundation (verified). Closure: 801.

801 — Text Foundation is verified and already active, so excluded from new-start choices. Its existing specification is specs/801-text-foundation/spec.md. Entries 802, 803 and 804 have no assigned specification directory; specs/802-normalize-text does not exist. No missing reference, cycle, ambiguous identity or undefined readiness rule was found. No choice or amendment is made by this inventory.
We can discuss dependency chains and which prerequisites unblock the most work before you choose. Keep this gate pending while answering those questions from the inventory; a question is not a selection. Select one exact listed entry or defer. Choosing a feature does not approve a roadmap patch.
